jobs.title: Security Guard - Night Shifts (Armed/Unarmed) - 1099
jobs.description:
Security Solutions of Texas in Fort Worth is seeking a Full Time Security Guard to protect client property from criminal activity and trespassing. The role requires keen observation, strong communication, and the ability to stay calm in high-pressure situations.

Responsibilities include patrolling grounds, reviewing surveillance, controlling entry, enforcing identification, and coordinating with local authorities as needed. This is a 1099 contractor role with shift coverage in Fort Worth, TX.

jobs.title: Overnight Security Lead – Flexible Hours & Training
jobs.description:
United Protective Services in Frisco, TX, is seeking an Overnight Varied Security Officer. This part-time role offers $17.00–$19.00/hour with opportunities for growth into supervisory positions. You will patrol posts, document incidents, and deliver dependable customer service while mentoring newer officers.

The position requires flexible hours, strong communication, reliability, and a professional demeanor in a dynamic environment. Reports to Trevor Anderson and supports client relationships.

jobs.title: Night Patrol & Incident Response Specialist
jobs.description:
Mesquite ISD is seeking an Overnight Mobile Security Guard to monitor district properties, patrol campuses and respond to alarms during non-school hours. The role requires documenting incidents and coordinating with authorities as needed.

Ideal candidates have 3+ years of security guard experience, ability to write incident reports, and are available for overnight shifts on a full-time basis. This position reports to the Fire & Security Systems Supervisor and involves on-call duties as needed.
